text: {"label":"Classroom Disruptive Behavior and Good Behavior Game","definition":"School-based interventions to reduce disruptive and challenging student behavior and increase appropriate classroom behavior, especially the Good Behavior Game, classroom management, rules and feedback, and function-based supports.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets reduction of disruptive and challenging behavior through classroom management and group contingencies, unlike instructional strategies for on-task responding, broad school dissemination of behavior analysis, or pediatric healthcare services."}
